Grandstream GWN7803 Pro – 24-Port Layer 2++ Managed Network Switch

The Grandstream GWN7803 Pro is an enterprise-grade Layer 2++ managed network switch designed for small and medium-sized businesses that require secure, scalable and high-performance wired networking. It provides 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 2 × 10Gbps SFP+ uplinks, advanced VLAN and QoS capabilities, IPv4/IPv6 support, comprehensive security features and flexible management options.

Unlike the PoE versions of the GWN7800 Pro family, the GWN7803 Pro is a non-PoE model, making it suitable where powered devices are supplied through separate PoE switches or injectors. Grandstream’s current product material identifies the GWN7803 Pro with 24 Gigabit ports, two 10Gbps SFP+ ports and 88Gbps switching capacity.

10Gbps SFP+ Uplinks

The GWN7803 Pro includes two high-speed 10Gbps SFP+ ports, providing significantly faster uplink options than traditional Gigabit SFP interfaces. These ports can be used for fiber connectivity, switch-to-switch links, aggregation connections and high-bandwidth network backbones.

For organizations running high-speed servers, Wi-Fi infrastructure, VoIP systems or multiple network segments, the 10Gbps uplinks can help reduce congestion between the access and aggregation layers.

Advanced VLAN and Network Segmentation

Network administrators can create structured network environments using 802.1Q VLANs, QinQ, MAC-based VLANs, protocol-based VLANs and Voice VLANs. Up to 4,000 VLANs are supported, allowing the switch to accommodate complex enterprise network designs.

Voice VLAN capabilities are particularly useful when deploying Grandstream IP phones alongside computers and other business devices on the same physical network.

Advanced QoS

Quality of Service features allow administrators to prioritize important traffic such as:

  • VoIP calls
  • Video conferencing
  • Business applications
  • Enterprise Wi-Fi
  • Critical network services

Traffic shaping, rate limiting, queue scheduling, port priority and priority mapping provide additional control over network traffic.

Enterprise Network Security

Security capabilities include 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication, RADIUS, TACACS+, ACLs, ARP Inspection, IP Source Guard, DHCP Snooping, port security, port isolation, storm control and DoS protection.

These features can help organizations establish controlled access between users, devices, VLANs and network resources.

Flexible Management

The GWN7803 Pro supports several management approaches, including its embedded WebUI controller, GDMS Networking cloud management, GWN Manager, GWN Series Routers and CLI.

This flexibility allows the switch to fit both centralized cloud-managed environments and organizations that prefer on-premise network management.

Non-PoE Enterprise Switching

Because the GWN7803 Pro does not provide PoE output, it is well suited to installations where PoE power is handled separately.

Typical examples include networks where access points, IP phones or cameras are connected through dedicated PoE switches or external PoE injectors. The non-PoE design can also be useful as an aggregation or distribution switch where connected devices do not require power from the network switch.

Schools and Universities

Hotels and Hospitality

Build structured wired networks for guest services, administration, VoIP, CCTV and Wi-Fi infrastructure.

VoIP Networks

Voice VLAN and QoS capabilities make the switch suitable for business IP telephone deployments.

ISP and Network Infrastructure

The combination of Gigabit access ports, 10Gbps uplinks, VLANs, routing and security features makes it suitable for selected ISP and managed-network environments.

Server and Data Networks

The two 10Gbps SFP+ interfaces provide high-speed connectivity to aggregation switches, servers and network backbones.

CCTV Infrastructure

The switch can serve as a high-speed non-PoE aggregation switch for surveillance networks where cameras receive power from separate PoE equipment.

720W PoE++ Power for High-Demand Devices

A major advantage of the GWN7806PH Pro is its high-capacity PoE++ architecture. All 48 Ethernet ports support PoE, with IEEE 802.3af/at/bt compatibility and up to 60W per port.

This makes the switch suitable for installations containing numerous powered endpoints, including:

  • Wi-Fi access points
  • IP phones
  • IP cameras
  • PTZ cameras
  • Video conferencing equipment
  • Pro AV equipment
  • IoT devices
  • Other PoE network endpoints

Grandstream also provides configurable PoE priorities, maximum power settings, scheduled PoE control and dynamic power negotiation through LLDP-MED.

Six 10Gbps SFP+ Uplinks

The six 10Gbps SFP+ ports provide high-speed fiber or DAC connectivity for network aggregation, server connections and backbone links. Up to six 10Gbps optical modules are supported, while RJ45-10G modules are supported subject to Grandstream’s specified insertion requirements.

For larger enterprise networks, these uplinks can help connect the access layer to core or distribution switches without creating a Gigabit uplink bottleneck.

Advanced Layer 2++ Networking

Network administrators can create sophisticated network architectures using VLANs, QinQ, MAC-based VLAN, protocol-based VLAN, VLAN translation and Voice VLAN. STP, RSTP, MSTP, PVST(+), RPVST(+) and ERPS provide additional options for network resilience and loop prevention.

Static routing supports communication between different network segments, while the GWN7806PH Pro also supports policy routing on the GWN7806 Pro models.

Enterprise Network Security

Security features include 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication, RADIUS, TACACS, ARP Inspection, IP/IPv6 Source Guard, DHCP Snooping, port isolation, port security, storm control and DoS protection. These capabilities help administrators segment networks and control access to critical resources.

Pro AV and Precision Timing

The GWN7800 Pro Series includes built-in Pro AV capabilities for professional audio and video deployments. IEEE 1588v2 PTP/Precision Time Protocol is also supported for precise synchronization between compatible network devices.

This makes the GWN7806PH Pro applicable to conference rooms, campuses, digital signage, entertainment venues, corporate AV installations and other multimedia environments.

High Availability and Stacking

For larger deployments, the GWN7806PH Pro supports stacking of up to eight switches. Stacking allows multiple physical switches to operate as a logical system, simplifying configuration and management while providing additional redundancy options.

The switch also supports 1+1 external redundant power supply architecture, while dual boot, system-file redundancy, link aggregation and multiple protection mechanisms contribute to improved network resilience.

Management Options

The GWN7806PH Pro provides several management methods:

Local Web GUI: Manage the switch and its embedded controller directly through the Web interface.

GDMS Networking: Use Grandstream’s cloud-based management platform for centralized network administration.

GWN Manager: Deploy an on-premise management platform for organizations requiring local management.

GWN App: Manage compatible GWN7800 Pro switches through the mobile application.

CLI: Administrators can use Console, Telnet or SSH for command-line management.

SNMP: SNMP v1, v2c and v3 are supported for network monitoring and management integration.

Ideal Applications

Enterprise Offices

Deploy the GWN7806PH Pro as a high-capacity access or distribution switch for workstations, IP phones, wireless APs, cameras and other business endpoints.

Hotels and Hospitality

Use the 48-port PoE++ platform to connect and power guest Wi-Fi access points, IP phones, CCTV cameras and other hotel infrastructure.

Schools and Universities

The switch can support campus network segmentation, high-density Wi-Fi, IP surveillance, VoIP and multimedia systems.

CCTV and Security Networks

Its 720W PoE budget provides substantial capacity for powering large numbers of compatible IP cameras and other security endpoints.

Data Centers and Server Rooms

Six 10Gbps SFP+ ports provide high-speed uplink options for servers, aggregation switches and network backbones.

Pro AV Installations

VLAN, QoS, multicast optimization and PTP capabilities make the platform suitable for professional audio/video environments.

ISP and Network Infrastructure

The combination of high port density, 10Gbps uplinks, VLANs, routing, QoS and security features makes the switch suitable for selected ISP, enterprise and managed-network deployments.

Key Benefits

  • High port density: Connect up to 48 Gigabit Ethernet devices.
  • Powerful PoE++: Deliver up to 60W per port with a 720W total budget.
  • Fast uplinks: Six 10Gbps SFP+ ports support high-speed backbone connectivity.

  • Enhanced security: Multiple authentication and network-protection mechanisms help secure LAN infrastructure.
  • Scalable architecture: Stack up to eight GWN7806 Pro switches.
  • Flexible management: Choose cloud, on-premise, Web GUI, mobile app or CLI management.
  • High availability: External redundant power support and reliability features help reduce infrastructure downtime.
  • Pro AV support: Built-in AV networking capabilities extend the switch into professional multimedia deployments.

Powerful PoE++ Connectivity

The GWN7803PH Pro supports IEEE 802.3af/at/bt, allowing it to power compatible PoE, PoE+ and PoE++ devices. Up to 60W can be supplied to an individual port, while the switch provides a total PoE budget of 400W.

This capability makes the switch suitable for higher-power wireless access points, IP cameras, video conferencing equipment, IP phones and other powered network endpoints. Grandstream also provides configurable PoE priorities and maximum power settings to help administrators manage available power.

Dual 10Gbps SFP+ Uplinks

Two 10Gbps SFP+ ports provide high-speed connectivity to aggregation switches, servers, routers and network-core infrastructure. These interfaces help prevent uplink bottlenecks when many Gigabit endpoints are transmitting simultaneously.

Fiber-based SFP+ connectivity also provides flexibility for longer-distance backbone connections, depending on the optical modules and fiber infrastructure selected.

Advanced Layer 2++ Networking

The switch supports up to 4,000 VLANs, 802.1Q VLAN tagging, QinQ, MAC-based VLAN, protocol-based VLAN, Voice VLAN and VLAN translation. Such capabilities allow administrators to separate voice, data, guest Wi-Fi, CCTV, management and other traffic logically across the same physical infrastructure.

Static IPv4 and IPv6 routing is also supported, while QoS features allow traffic to be prioritized according to port, DSCP, IP precedence and queue-scheduling requirements.

Enterprise-Grade Security

Security functions include 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication, RADIUS, TACACS+, ACLs, DHCP Snooping, ARP Inspection, IP/IPv6 Source Guard and DoS protection. Port isolation, sticky MAC, storm control and loop protection provide additional mechanisms for controlling network access and abnormal traffic.

Network administrators can therefore implement multiple layers of authentication, segmentation and traffic protection across business networks.

Pro AV Support

The GWN7800 Pro Series includes Pro AV capabilities for professional audio and video networking environments. IEEE 1588v2 PTP support provides precise time synchronization for applications where accurate timing is important.

These capabilities make the GWN7803PH Pro suitable for selected enterprise AV, education, media, retail and entertainment deployments.

Redundant Power and Reliability

The GWN7803PH Pro supports a 1+1 external redundant power supply architecture, providing an additional option for maintaining network availability in environments where power redundancy is important. Grandstream also documents power-supply and fan monitoring, temperature monitoring, surge protection and other reliability features.

A network administrator can therefore incorporate additional power resilience into suitable enterprise deployments.

Network Management

Management options include the local Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, GDMS Networking, GWN Manager and GWN Series Routers. Grandstream’s embedded controller is built into the Web interface, while GDMS Networking provides cloud-based management and GWN Manager provides an on-premise management option.

Remote provisioning, monitoring and centralized administration can simplify management when multiple Grandstream switches and access points are deployed across an organization.
